title: Exemption Validation Request
description: Request body for POST /exemptions/validate. Validates an exemption credential already on file with the provider. Failure uses UTCS-5xxx and MUST NOT be reported as a successful zero-tax determination. A successful validation exempts nothing; exemption takes effect only when a determination applies the certificate.

certificate_id.description: Exemption certificate identifier on file with the provider.

jurisdiction.description: Jurisdiction to validate the exemption against.

product_tax_code.description: Tax code of the product to check exemption applicability.
